name: QR campaigns

requirements.text: Every owned short link has one derived SVG QR that encodes its canonical public URL; existing links are backfilled without fabricating historical QR scans.
Legacy link QR delivery obeys final short-link controls; persisted campaign downloads encode /q/{code} and cannot bypass QR controls or scan analytics.
Workspaces create QR campaigns for direct HTTP(S) targets or same-workspace links with active, schedule, access-code, and maximum-scan controls.
QR lists provide workspace-scoped CSV export and insights derived only from QR scan records.
Campaigns support sharing metadata, allowlisted visual styling with a live creation preview, and private workspace-owned logo uploads with validated image formats and cleanup.
Campaign downloads provide SVG, PNG, JPEG, and WebP through an allowlisted format route with correct MIME types and deterministic filenames.

externalPrerequisites: Production deployments must configure and verify durable private storage for uploaded QR logos under storage/app/private/qr-logos; the local disk is not a production durability guarantee.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Scans increment only after the locked campaign row confirms the current required access-code version, target integrity, active and schedule state, and maximum-scan allowance.
A linked QR defers final controls to its owned link without double-counting.
Logo and link references cannot cross workspace boundaries.
Workspace QR CSV export remains available when an individual stored target is invalid; only that row's target_url is blank.
Campaign insights include the scoped linked short-link slug and title when a campaign targets a workspace link.

observedBehaviors: QR campaigns appear as rows with thumbnail previews and row actions.
A create action and list toolbar are visible.
A QR creation dialog pairs destination/title inputs with a QR preview.
Tracking, retargeting, password, and schedule affordances appear in the dialog footer.

implementationEvidence.description: QrCodeTest passed with 37 tests and 360 assertions, including scoped link insights, locked access-code version revalidation, invalid-target CSV row isolation, controls, previews, analytics, formats, and logo lifecycle; ProductCatalogTest passed with 3 tests and 10,447 assertions; the full Laravel suite passed with 365 tests and 13,994 assertions.
implementationEvidence.reference: QrCodeTest, ProductCatalogTest, and php artisan test.

implementationEvidence.description: A disposable persistent SQLite database was migrated, rolled back to pre-QR schema, seeded with a link and historical click, then migrated again; link fields and click survived, one linked QR was backfilled, and no QR scans were fabricated.
implementationEvidence.reference: Isolated migration/backfill smoke run; temporary database removed after assertions.

implementationEvidence.description: npm run types:check, targeted QR UI formatting/lint, Pint --test for changed PHP files, and the production Vite build passed; the build emitted the optional fontaine font-fallback optimization warning.
implementationEvidence.reference: npm run types:check; npx vp check --fix on the changed QR form/list; Pint --test on changed QR controllers/service/tests; isolated npm run build.

implementationEvidence.description: OpenCV QRCodeDetector decoded generated SVG, PNG, JPEG, and WebP files to the same /q/{code} campaign URL; owned temporary QR render artifacts and the disposable browser session/database files were removed afterward.
implementationEvidence.reference: QrCodeRenderer output decoded with OpenCV 4 QRCodeDetector; expected payload suffix /q/aqhowfsbcwkt; temporary files absent after cleanup.

implementationEvidence.description: A workspace owner created a direct campaign with sharing metadata, an access code, max scans=2, and a custom #123456 foreground. The live draft preview used the selected style; the public route showed an unlock gate without counting a scan, and insights remained at 0. The owner exported campaign CSV and downloaded the campaign SVG.
The platform-admin account opened /admin; its personal-workspace QR list showed 0 campaigns, and the owner-owned campaign 5 insights route returned 404.
